stage: Research; original head_on_13 full episode only
hypothesis: Acquire the frozen backup while margin exists at the original episode start, then preserve it across admitted main actions, rejections and planner lateness.
only_experimental_change: start at original t=0 state [0,0,0,0], target [0,0], empty queue/previous; no fixture warm start. Added lifecycle and timing instrumentation, version/dynamics validation and transaction deadline rollback do not change the frozen model or action selection.
frozen: original head_on seed13, ideal source-age-corrected CV, search proposal/beam64/horizon2s/cost, nine backup actions, .1s delay/.05s control/.01s plant, vmax .5/amax .8, original padded checker and CV safe-rest certificate; physical clearance >=.05m
normal_first: Initial acquisition unavailable stops all full-episode runs. Run normal B/C0/C1; inspect lifecycle and one unchanged confirmation. No lateness while normal C1 has collision, invalid reserve or intrinsic deadline failure.
lateness: same 80ms availability every sixth control slot as archived experiment; busy planner skips a slot, C1 executor continues. Require a normal results.json proof with C1 initialization, cross-cycle hold, no collision/invalid and total p99<=40/max<=50 before running.
metrics: planner, revalidation, acquisition/replacement and total per-cycle latency including IPC/transaction/executor preparation; mean/min/p05/p50/p95/p99/max; initialization separately. Report injected response misses separately, never erase them.
lifecycle: INITIALIZING, HELD, REVALIDATED, REPLACED, EXECUTING_BACKUP, SAFE_REST, INVALID, UNAVAILABLE; reason, plan revision, backup lineage/acquired epoch, absolute events/cursor, immutable queue/version, source/version, assumptions and certificate. Actual execution owner is carried through immutable queue.

gate.completion: original 40s absolute timeout, .15m goal and 3s observation

decision: Go-to-36 only after safe completed normal/late episodes, explanatory persistence and full budget. Modify for bounded non-scenario transaction/lifecycle defect with signal. Stop for unavailable start, collision, mechanism invalidation, deadline failure, timeout-brake-only benefit or need for parameter/library/fixture changes. No automatic 36 dispatch.
repeat: one minimal implementation audit and unchanged confirmation on failure; no tuning rescue
data: raw trajectories/full lifecycle/full logs/build external; only small summaries/manifest/report in Git
